snippet.text: def finalAngular (d : TailData) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := flattened d p * Real.exp (releaseAdjustment d (p.1 - d.releaseStart)) * (tailShape d (p.1 - tailStart d) / (1 - d.rho)) — the complete constructed angular schedule without the pressure-neutral azimuthal correction, i.e. the paper's E_id,sched; finalAngular_before (L570) with angular_ideal (OutgoingSchedule.lean L183) gives P * shape η * exp (y/10) on the ideal prefix, matching the paper's E = P_* f(η) e^{y/10}
